synopsis: NASA-HDBK-7009B was finalized on 3 February 2026, consistent with Chapter 12's February 2026 dating [f14607, f9742]. The handbook adds guidance for AI-based models [f9742]. Chapter 12 identifies that guidance as applicable to the perception-model gap, but the supplied facts do not specify how it closes that gap [f10341].

relations.note: Provides the exact finalization date within the reported publication month.
Identifies the perception-model gap as an application of the AI guidance.
